shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Only on what floats over content: graph legend, jump-to-latest button.

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: Live status dots and the streaming cursor; off under reduced motion.

components.name: Button
components.description: Default action: hairline border on Sheet, 44 px.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; min-width:44px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:6px; background:var(--surface); padding:0 0.9rem; color:var(--fg); font-weight:500; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color:var(--muted); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action of a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; border:1px solid var(--accent); border-radius:6px; background:var(--accent); padding:0 0.9rem; color:var(--accent-fg); font-weight:500; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Text input, 16 px text so iOS does not zoom.
components.css: .ds-field { width:100%; height:44px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:6px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--fg); padding:0 0.75rem; font-size:16px; } .ds-field::placeholder { color:var(--muted); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A dot and a word; color is never the only cue.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:9999px; background:var(--surface); padding:2px 8px; font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:var(--tone-attention); } .ds-dot { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:9999px; background:currentColor; }

components.name: Choice
components.description: One radio of a group drawn as a box; the checked one carries the accent.
components.css: .ds-choice { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; padding:0 0.75rem; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-choice:has(:checked) { border-color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-soft); }

narrative.overview: Calin is a bench a developer comes back to all day. The interface is quiet so that the work is loud: content fills the space; chrome is hairlines, small labels and the system font. Color is spent on one thing at a time: what needs the user.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-gray tinted neutrals, one blue accent, four status tones that always come with a word.
Hairline borders and tonal steps (bg, surface, sunken) instead of shadows.
System sans for prose and UI, system mono for anything the machine wrote.
44 px touch targets everywhere, 16 px form text so iOS does not zoom.
Dense type: 15 px body, 14 px secondary, 12 px labels; one 20 px page title.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Color means state. The accent marks where the user acts; the tones mark status. Nothing is colored for decoration.

rules.name: The Word Beside The Dot Rule
rules.body: A status is a dot and a word, never color alone.

rules.name: The Machine Wrote It Rule
rules.body: Paths, branch names, commands, ids and amounts are mono; prose is never mono.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing at rest casts a shadow; a shadow means this floats above.

dos: Do take every color from a token, with a light and a dark value.
Do keep text at 4.5:1 or more on its surface in both themes.
Do pair every status color with its word.
Do keep targets at 44 px and form text at 16 px.
Do use mono for machine-made strings and the system sans for everything else.
donts: Don't hard-code a color in a component, an SVG attribute or a JavaScript theme object.
Don't add a second accent, gradients, or shadows on things at rest.
Don't fetch fonts or scripts from a third party: the CSP allows the app's origin only.
Don't animate without a state change behind it, and honor reduced motion.
